propositions: init.py at 786 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap with only 14 lines of headroom, requiring reduction to at or below 650 LOC to stay within the near-cap band

init.py contains two independent subsystems with no calls between them: tracker provisioning (init command) and tickets-branch convergence units (called only by ensures._registry), creating a valid concern boundary for splitting

The ensure units and their owned content templates (_GITIGNORE, _GITATTRIBUTES) must move together to _init_ensures.py because the units are the sole readers of those templates and their caller (ensures._registry) will lazy-import them by name

The _untrack_runtime_markers_unit and _UNTRACK_BATCH constant must remain in init.py because the unit repairs legacy INDEX state rather than materializing artifacts, and test_ensures_untrack_markers.py patches _UNTRACK_BATCH as an init module attribute, so separation would silently break test coverage
Re-exporting the moved units from init.py preserves all existing module-level references and monkeypatch bindings while updating ensures.py's docstring to name the new module as the units' home
